digest.component_or_area: IAM and Bedrock authorization for review-bot container
propositions: The review-bot container requires IAM authorization to invoke the Bedrock Converse API against Claude foundation models, scoped to the existing instance role without modifying the role declaration contract in iam.tf.

The Bedrock Converse API authorizes against bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream actions, not bedrock:Converse; policy simulators cannot resolve this; only real calls from the scoped role reveal the authorizing action.

IMDS reachability from the review-bot container must be verified before deciding whether to modify metadata_options http_put_response_hop_limit; the opcert container's working SSM fetch proves IMDS is reachable on the default bridge.

The inference-profile ARN scope requires both region and profile-prefix wildcards to permit cross-region routing and global.* profile forms, not us-east-1 or us.* pinning; runtime denial occurs under under-scoped ARNs.

A policy simulator result showing implicitDeny for bedrock:Converse does not prove Converse is the required action; only a real Converse call from the scoped role reveals which action the Bedrock service checks.
